2. **Permit.** Read the four AcroForm fields from the PDF (`organizer`, `event_date`, `location`, `attendees`) and mapped Ines' details: Tidewater Studio / 2026-12-05 / North Cove Lawn / about 40. Flattened by removing `/AcroForm` and `/Annots` and drawing the values into the page content stream.

[result]

- Originals `launch.jpg` and `permit-form.pdf` are untouched.

Assumptions I made (brief left these open):
- "Saturday 5 December 2026" → `event_date` in `YYYY-MM-DD` format per the field label: `2026-12-05`.
- "People: about 40" → `attendees` as the literal string `about 40` (field is a free-text field, not numeric).
- "Flattened" → render the values as static page text and strip the form/annotations so they can't be edited (no separate appearance streams needed).
- Crop anchor: right edge, chosen because the balloon is on the right side, so it survives the 3:2→4:5 crop with room to spare.

Evidence I trust: the byte-level PDF check (content ops present, no AcroForm/Annots) and PIL re-detection of the balloon inside the final 1080x1350. I did not get a visual render (the local browser couldn't open a `file://` PDF), so my correctness claim rests on the decompressed content stream, not a screenshot.

[limitation] No rendered visual confirmation of the PDF layout; correctness is verified structurally (text ops + removed form fields). If you want, I can render it to an image to eyeball alignment.
